content.text: You're right — and the row is still worth keeping, because the mapper needs an anchor and the anchor has to be a named address. Dropping it would mean every lookup starts from an unnamed symbol, which is the reason the convention was written down in the first place. The table lists a 1.16.2 address beside each entry so that a reviewer can check the pairing without re-deriving it, and that is the whole point of the column.
